Subject: Mutual Action Plan and 4-week Close Playbook

Hi Jim / Patricia —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and the evaluation testcases we discussed. Goal: a 4-week evaluation window that aligns technical verification, procurement, and an operational cutover so we can reach a signed SOW and target launch in July.

High-level acceptance criteria (summary):
- Functional: end-to-end inference on representative dataset with >= 95% parity vs baseline on key clinical intent labels.
- Performance: 95th-percentile latency <= 220ms for batch size = 1 (p99 budgeted fallback to alternative model if overloaded).
- Cost/run: token cost within 15% of quoted estimator for projected 100k tokens/day workload.
- Reliability: sustained KV cache hit-rate >= 40% for repeated prompts in scenario tests.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 evidence + KMS key exchange completed before production cutover.

Exit gates (what must be true to sign SOW):
1) Eval acceptance tests green (owners listed in MAP sheet).
2) Procurement PO or signed SOW in DocuSign.
3) Dedicated capacity assessment (if needed) and resource reservation.
4) Post-cutover rollback playbook shared and verified.

Owners and immediate asks:
- Jim: confirm dataset owners and an initial 50k sample by EOW (we'll use these for smoke and concordance tests).
- Patricia: procurement timeline and any required legal clause redlines (we attached SOW draft).
- Karthik (cc): will own performance test harness and telemetry acceptance.

Attachments: MAP-Helix-v1.xlsx, Helix-eval-testcases.pdf

Please review the MAP and reply with any changes to owners or acceptance thresholds by Thu, Jun 3. If that works, we'll lock a test schedule and share a DocuSign SOW link.

Thanks—

Soojin — quick technical notes / suggested edits to the acceptance list: 

Nice summary. Couple of things to tighten so the eval is unambiguous: 
- Add an Liveness SLO: <98% successful token generation (no timeouts) across representative 24-hour load window.
- Clarify model variant for the baseline parity (we should pin to gpt-alloc-v2-q4_0 for the evaluation runs).
- Add a smoke concurrency test: 10 concurrent streams for 1 hour to validate KV cache behavior; target <10% throughput degradation.
- Telemetry owner: Jordan to instrument per-route token counters and per-request trace IDs (required for acceptance evidence).
- Test pass rule: each acceptance test should specify 3 runs over different seeds/days; pass if 2/3 runs meet threshold.

Procurement note: we should have a conditional milestone in the MAP that says 'SOW signed' triggers a 7-day reservation window for dedicated capacity or we fallback to hosted tier auto-scale. Monica — can you draft that procurement milestone and a suggested PO language?

I'll update the MAP spreadsheet with the variant pins and test harness tasks. Pushing the updated sheet by EOD.

-Karthik

2) SOC2 / security: Helix requires SOC2 Type II attestation within the last 12 months and encryption key ownership details (KMS) documented. We will accept a written plan + timeline during the eval but final evidence needs to be in place before production.
3) PO: Our procurement prefers a 30-day net payment term; if Redwood prefers milestone invoicing, please indicate milestone definitions in the SOW.
